items: First Electric Train: Introduced on 3rd February 1925 between Victoria Terminus and Kurla.
Official Mascot: 'Bholu the Guard Elephant' was unveiled in 2002 to commemorate the 150th anniversary of Indian Railways.
Track Dimensions: Broad Gauge width is strictly 1.676 m (5 ft 6 in), a frequently asked stat in RRB NTPC and Group D exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India ran between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on 16th April 1853.
Indian Railways was official nationalised in 1951 and has grown into one of the largest rail networks in the world.
Bholu, an elephant dressed as a railway guard holding a signal lamp, serves as the official mascot of Indian Railways.
Indian Railways predominantly operates on three track gauges: Broad Gauge (1.676 m), Meter Gauge (1.000 m), and Narrow Gauge (0.762 m / 0.610 m).
